entries.identity: Empress Dou, consort of Emperor Wen and mother of Emperor Jing and Liu Wu; not later empresses named Dou
entries.event: Named as the crown prince's mother and selected as empress in Wen's first year, third lunar month
entries.limits: Supplementary external attestation only. It does not date the genealogy in Shiji 58, supply a birth/death year, or make her Can's or Sheng's mother.

entries.identity: Emperor Jing of Han, Qi, Emperor Wen's crown prince, son of Empress Dou
entries.event: Qi is nominated and accepted as crown prince in Wen's first year, first lunar month
entries.limits: Supplementary external attestation, not a date stated in Shiji 58's genealogy. This is an appointment date, not a birth year or emperor's accession date.
